title: Fix Select.Item empty value prop validation error

requirements.text: Update all Select.Item components in PropertyForm.tsx to have non-empty value props. Replace any empty string values with meaningful string values (e.g., 'none', 'unspecified', or appropriate default values) to prevent Select validation errors while maintaining the ability to clear selections using the Select component's built-in empty string handling.

quotes: A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string. This is because the Select value can be set to an empty string to clear the selection and show the placeholder.

acceptanceCriteria: All Select.Item components have non-empty string value props
No validation errors appear in the console regarding Select.Item values
Select components can still be cleared and show placeholders when needed
Form functionality for property type, furnishing status, and area selections remains unchanged

requirements.text: Update all Select.Item components in PropertySearchBar.tsx to have non-empty value props. Replace any empty string values with meaningful string values while ensuring the search filter logic correctly handles both cleared states and selected values.

quotes: A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string.

acceptanceCriteria: All Select.Item components in the search bar have non-empty string value props
Search filters work correctly with both cleared and selected states
No validation errors appear for Select.Item components
Filter placeholders display correctly when no selection is made

constraints: Do not modify the Select component itself from frontend/src/components/ui
Maintain existing form validation logic and search functionality
Preserve the user experience for clearing selections and showing placeholders
nonGoals: Changing the overall form or search bar structure
Modifying backend data models or validation
